readOnlyScope: Only generic PostgreSQL exported repeatable-read snapshot, same-snapshot pg_dump, independently bracketed sequences, pg_restore --list, portable read-only WAL-aware legacy SQLite snapshots, private complete file/owner inventory, metadata/source/runtime checks. No login, business HTTP, container signal, environment update, database restore or sequence reset.
permissionProofScope: All actual business users/roles/password hashes/factory/customer/menu authorization rows are included in typed PostgreSQL table fingerprints; no claim that every possible PostgreSQL catalog ACL/RLS attribute is enumerated.
privateEvidence: New mode0700 archive and umask077, private env/inspect/stderr/tracebacks/DB dump/file bytes; public receipt limited to booleans, counts, fixed SHAs and safe failure stage/type.
